author: britainunspun
text:
The final GTA 6 trailer is out. It lands on 19 November, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PC version announced yet.

Worth remembering where it comes from. Grand Theft Auto started at DMA Design in Dundee in 1997. The lead studio today is Rockstar North in Edinburgh. One of the biggest launches of the year is made in Scotland.

GTA 5 came out in September 2013. That is a thirteen year wait, with two delays along the way.

George has waited less time for a Scottish bus. Only just.

The facts. No spin.

#GeorgeOhWell #GTA6 #RockstarNorth
@IGN @RockstarGames @eurogamer
